apple.name: Esha by Korlix
apple.subtitle: Beauty routines, made personal
apple.promotional_text: Explore beauty products, build a routine around your budget, and keep your favorites and illustrated looks together in Esha by Korlix.
apple.description:
Make room for your own kind of beauty. Esha by Korlix brings product discovery, guided routines and a personal beauty collection together.

DISCOVER YOUR NEXT FAVORITE
Explore a starter catalog of makeup, lipstick, lip gloss, lashes, body wash and lotion. Search and filter categories, read sourced product details and open the manufacturer's page to check the current shade, size, price and availability.

BUILD A ROUTINE AROUND YOUR BUDGET
Choose your preferences and new-product budget to create a guided beauty edit. Include products you already own, review the estimated cost and save the routine for later. Product prices are dated estimates before tax and shipping. Items without a verified price show Check price. Unknown purchase prices never count as free in a new-product budget.

KEEP YOUR VANITY TOGETHER
Save favorites, mark products you own, and keep your routines and looks in one place. Explore with a guest collection on your device, or sign in to a shared Korlix account to sync an account collection.

PLAY WITH AN ILLUSTRATED LOOK
Explore lip colors, satin or gloss finishes and lash styles in the look studio, then save the combinations you like. The studio uses a stylized illustration and does not scan your face or provide a selfie try-on.

OPTIONAL LIVE AI CONSULTATIONS
When the service and store offer are available, an optional Esha membership adds live AI beauty consultations. Ask about makeup, lip pairings, lashes or body-care preferences. Before you send a question, Esha asks for permission to share your question and recent conversation with Korlix and OpenAI. Sharing saved beauty preferences is a separate choice. You can withdraw permission for future requests and report an answer in the app.

MEMBERSHIP DETAILS
When offered, eligible subscribers may receive 3 days free, then US $4.99 per month. The App Store shows your actual local price and eligible offer before purchase. The app shows the included consultation allowance before purchase; live consultations also require an active verified membership and available consultations. Membership renews automatically until canceled through your store account. Use Restore purchases or Manage subscription in Esha. Installing the app or creating an account does not start a trial. Cosmetics are purchased separately. Esha membership does not upgrade another Korlix plan.

Esha offers cosmetic guidance. It does not diagnose conditions, provide medical treatment or guarantee an exact shade match. Check current product details before buying.
